fact: Allegedly the driver failed to slow for a single yellow flag at Turns 1 and 2.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5 b) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, and in-car video evidence. No yellow flag and no steering wheel light was visible to the driver through the yellow flag sector. A green light panel was visible as the car neared the end of the sector and the telemetry demonstrated that the driver did make a reduction in throttle.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 63 Alleged Failure To Slow For Yellow Flags
to: The Team Manager, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team
